measurement_boundary: split AFD MoE stage: A-side FP8 quant, route dispatch, wait, top-k combine, and routed-output scaling; F-side persistent expert L1, model-specific activation, requant, L2, and return; includes fused replicated shared expert when the profile declares one; excludes router, attention, dense-only layers, residual, sampling, and coordinator

model_profile.checkpoint_precision: synthetic deterministic BF16 benchmark weights quantized to E2M1 with UE8M0 block-32 scales; no checkpoint weights are loaded

workload.accepted_tokens_note: acceptance is intentionally not applied to kernel latency; it converts candidate output to useful tokens at the system-model layer
workload.input_policy: fixed deterministic representative hidden state per A-rank and lane; the same input is reused independently for every measured MoE layer

stability_contract: stage CUDA CV <= 3% and finite output on every rank
